Dilip Khandelwal And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on
10 April, 2024
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:63283
Court No. - 89

Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 1414 of 2024
Applicant :- Dilip Khandelwal And 2 Others

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- G.A.,Vikas Srivastava
Hon'ble Mayank Kumar Jain,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for applicants, learned Additional Government Advocate for the State and perused the record.

2. The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed for quashing the entire proceedings of Criminal Complaint Case No. 125 of 2022, pending before the learned Civil Judge (J.D.)/F.T.C. (offence against the women) Bhadohi at Gyanpur as well as impugned summoning order dated 14.12.2022 and Bailable Warrant dated 26.10.2023, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. against the applicants.

entities.text: Civil Judge (J.D.)/F.T.C. (offence against the women) Bhadohi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is also prayed to stay the further proceeding of aforesaid case during pendency of the present application.
3. It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicants that applicant No. 1 is the husband of the daughter of opposite party No. 2, namely, Seema Patwa.
The applicant No. 2 is the brother and applicant No. 3 is Nephew (Bhanja) of applicant No. 1.

Seema Patwa performed her marriage,
without obtaining divorce to the first husband, namely, Shanti Lal with one Nirmal Gupta.
and later on, she gave divorce to Nirmal Gupta.

The marriage of the applicant No. 1 was performed with Dilip Khandelwal And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 10 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/87022140/
1 Seema Patwa on 25.7.2018.

entities.text: Dilip Khandelwal And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant No. 1 lodged an F.I.R. against Seema Patwa and her family members as Case Crime No. 275 of 2021 under Sections 420, 406, 379, 495, 382, 506 and 120B I.P.C. at P.S. Gangapur City, District Sawai Madhopur, Rajsthan.

Seema Patwa filed a Case No.
232 of 2021 on 16.6.2021 under Section 12 of Domestic Violence Act against applicant no.1.

It is submitted that distance between Gangapur City and Bhadohi is around 900 kilometer, therefore,
the allegation against applicants in the complaint are not reliable as well they are baseless.
4.

Per contra learned Additional Government Advocate opposed the contentions made by learned counsel for the applicants and submitted that marriage of applicant No. 1 was performed with Seema Patwa on 25.7.2018 when applicant No. 1 committed indecent activity with the daughter of opposite party No. 2, namely, Seema Patwa, she lodged a criminal case against the applicant.
The cognizance order has been passed after considering the evidence available on record, therefore, the present application deserves to be dismissed.

5. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and after going through the available record,
the prayer for quashing of the entire proceedings of aforesaid case, is refused.

6. However, it is provided that in case the applicant applies for bail within a period of 30 days from today, his application for bail shall be considered and disposed of expeditiously in view of law laid down by the Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, 2022 SCC OnLine SC 825.
7.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, 2022 SCC OnLine SC 825
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: For a period of 30 days or till the applicant surrenders and applies for bail, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant in the aforesaid case.
8. With the aforesaid directions, this application is finally disposed of.

Order Date :- 10.4.2024 SY  Dilip Khandelwal And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 10 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/87022140/
